SELECT
  a.id,
  a.name,
  SUM(b.order_total) AS revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_code,
    order_number,
    SUM(total_amount) AS order_total
  FROM billing
  GROUP BY store_code, order_number
) b
JOIN sales_order_line sol
  ON sol.store_code = b.store_code
 AND sol.order_number = b.order_number
JOIN product p
  ON p.id = sol.product_id
JOIN album al
  ON al.id = p.album_id
JOIN artist a
  ON a.id = al.artist_id
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
